accept.why: wp-admin only: the case-study metabox's own screen chrome (#dcdcde, #fff match WordPress admin's greys) and its before/after score labels (#ff4a1c, #39a935). The theme's palette variables are not a dependable input on that admin screen, and the two label colours have no palette equivalent — mapping them would change how the admin looks for no visitor-facing gain. Every front-end stylesheet in this plugin is tokens only (e150741 + the rgba shadows, 2026-09-28).
